connection.description: FHIR server connection — required for run_template; a misconfigured edge must not fall back to a public server.

parameters.description: Route execution parameters including DB credentials, SQL, etc.

db_type.description: Database the db_* fields name. Absent means postgresql; core sends it only for a non-Postgres source. The Go edge agent runs postgresql, mysql, mariadb and mssql and replies 'Unsupported db_type' to any other.

operation.description: Parametric operation (create, update, delete, select, read, write_with_events, introspect). Its presence selects the parametric path; the Go edge agent refuses a raw 'sql' payload.

introspect.description: operation=introspect only: the catalog question. The reply is a query reply whose rows carry the columns of the Postgres information_schema SELECT for that kind (postgres_external _helpers.build_*_sql), answered by the edge from the database's own catalog. Core sends it for a non-Postgres source (db_type mysql, mariadb or mssql).

schema_name.description: operation=introspect: the schema (on MySQL, the database) every kind but schemas asks about.

table_name.description: The table a parametric operation targets; for operation=introspect, the table columns, primary_keys, foreign_keys and check_enums ask about.

mcp_server_url.description: adr-158 — target MCP server endpoint (http[s]:// for streamable-HTTP/SSE transport). Presence of mcp_tool selects the MCP transport at the controller.

mcp_transport.description: adr-158 — MCP transport binding. 'http' = streamable-HTTP JSON-RPC (default); 'sse' = HTTP+SSE; 'stdio' = local child process (mcp_command).

mcp_command.description: adr-158 — for mcp_transport=stdio: the local command line launching the MCP server as a child process.

mcp_tool.description: adr-158 — the MCP tool name to invoke (tools/call). Its presence selects the MCP transport.

mcp_arguments.description: adr-158 — arguments object passed to the MCP tool call.

mcp_token.description: adr-158 — bearer-token convenience for the MCP server; becomes Authorization: Bearer <token> unless mcp_headers already supplies Authorization. Resolved from the credential store at dispatch. Stays local to the controller.

mcp_headers.description: adr-158 — arbitrary custom request headers applied to every MCP request (e.g. Compass needs X-API-Key + X-Project). Values resolved from the credential store at dispatch; stay local to the controller.

response_topic.description: MQTT topic to publish result to
